comment: Corpus slug -> MCP Registry id. Built 2026-10-18 via registry search API. 11 of 22 mapped, 11 null. null = not in registry, no official entry, or registry entry is a different artifact.

chrome-devtools.note: official; npm and registry track same artifact

hostinger.note: official; registry version line 0.1.x-1.x is disjoint from npm 2.x (two separate artifacts under one name)

figma.note: community server we track; the official Figma MCP is com.figma.mcp/mcp (remote hosted, not in our corpus)

sentry.note: official; registry lists npm @sentry/mcp-server as the package - confirmed same artifact as our corpus

sap-fiori.note: official; registry versions 0.6.49-1.12.0 lag behind npm 1.13+ (maintainer has not published recent versions to registry)

ui5.note: official; registry latest 0.3.2 matches npm latest; confirmed same artifact

firebase.note: official; registry v0.3.0 lags behind npm 0.4.4

apify.note: registry has com.apify/apify-mcp-server (versions 0.10-0.15) but our corpus tracks @apify/actors-mcp-server (0.16-0.18) - different artifacts, different npm packages

transcend.note: not in registry; searched transcend, transcend mcp - zero results

notion.note: no official @notionhq entry; community alternatives exist

netlify.note: all entries are app.netlify.* format (hosted namespace), not io.github.*; no official npm @netlify/mcp entry

bybit.note: not in registry; trading-mcp npm package unregistered

hubspot.note: no official HubSpot entry; community alternatives exist

shopify.note: no official @shopify/dev-mcp entry; community shopify MCP servers exist
